justification: Changes how every DCP re-extraction cleans doubled-glyph text before it reaches the review queue and, once approved, the served rules. A wrong rule either deletes real conditions and values or lets garbage through.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_dcp_extraction_fidelity.py tests/test_dcp_review_enqueue.py tests/test_ocr_fallback.py -o addopts= -q
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Doubled text that can be restored is blanked (a condition, a value, or a whole guidance line), a running header (wholly doubled line that repeats or names the plan) survives, real doubled-looking values ('1100 3300mm', 'AABB1122', '2288') or two-letter labels ('Lots AA BB CC') are changed, or any pre-existing stripping expectation regresses.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 73 passed. Mutations: never restore -> 9 failed; never drop headers -> 1; drop every wholly doubled line -> 4; numbers count as doubled words -> 1 (after adding the AABB1122 fixture; it survived without it); one letter is a doubled word -> 5. Sol cross-review on the first push found 3 HIGH defects in the earlier version (a wholly doubled condition line deleted; '1100 3300mm' halved; 'mmiinniimmuumm sseettbbaacckk 6 mm' reduced to '6'); each is now a test. Old vs new over production text: 30,798 served provisions -> 20 differ, 8,646 queued rows -> 15 differ, and every word the old output has that the new lacks is a doubled fragment. Fresh extraction of ku_ring_gai part 8 (2,822 lines): the old cleaner deleted a 12-line guidance paragraph ('Building facades are to be articulated into a series of vertically proportioned bays...') and left 'ttoo bbee aa ooff'; the new one restores it, adds no header lines, and leaves 0 doubled runs.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Production regulatory_provisions text for campbelltown 3_7_1_6, 3_8_2, 3_7_3 and city_of_sydney 6_3_14_4, and dcp_review_queue 82464/82469 (ku_ring_gai), read 2026-09-17; the residue was reproduced by running DCPExtractor on ku_ring_gai/section-a-part-8-mixed-use (R2 v1.2-2026-09-01).

pre_impl.existing_data: 25 doubled-glyph hits in served provisions (campbelltown 14, city_of_sydney 8, ku_ring_gai 3) and 20 in queued new_text (ku_ring_gai 10, woollahra 6, canterbury_bankstown 4); 8 of the 30 pending ku_ring_gai rows held on 2026-09-17 carry doubled residue.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The 2026-09-07 fix (#1058) treated all doubled text as figure-label bleed and blanked it; campbelltown's served rules show doubled text can be the rule itself, so blanking deleted conditions and values, and short doubled words left behind in caption lines were never removed.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Extends strip_garbled_header_lines and keeps _strip_garbled_phrase_spans and all its tests unchanged; pdfplumber dedupe_chars was measured and does not remove these glyphs, so it is not used.

functions.name: strip_garbled_header_lines
functions.input: Extracted provision text (str or None), before it is written to the review queue.
functions.output: Each line with doubled runs restored; a wholly doubled line dropped only when it repeats in the text or names the plan; remaining unrestorable garble stripped and lines still dominated by doubling dropped.
functions.if_none: None or empty text is returned unchanged.

functions.name: _undouble_glyph_runs
functions.input: A single line of extracted provision text, before phrase stripping.
functions.output: The line with each run of consecutive fully doubled tokens collapsed, when the run contains a doubled word (no digits, two or more distinct letters).
functions.if_none: A line with no qualifying run is returned unchanged.

values.value: doubled word: no digits and >= 2 distinct letters
values.if_missing: Real values such as '1100 3300mm' or codes such as 'AABB1122' would be halved.

break_it.scenario: A real value is written with repeated digits: 'Minimum 1100 mm setback', 'NSW 2288', 'a 3300mm wide driveway'.
break_it.what_happens: Un-doubling would turn 1100 into 10 and serve a wrong number.
break_it.how: A number is collapsed only inside a run that also holds a doubled word (no digits, two distinct letters). Pinned by test_real_doubled_numbers_and_labels_are_never_touched and test_adjacent_real_numbers_are_not_halved.

break_it.scenario: A plan uses two-letter identifiers: 'Lots AA BB CC are subject to separate controls'.
break_it.what_happens: Un-doubling would print 'Lots A B C'.
break_it.how: Two-character tokens alone never qualify; the Sol-reviewed 5-token spaced-letter rule is unchanged.

break_it.scenario: A doubled rule sits on its own short line ('rroooomm,, bbuutt oonnllyy iiff::').
break_it.what_happens: Blanking it would silently drop a condition from a served rule.
break_it.how: Every restorable doubled run is restored before any line is judged; a wholly doubled line is dropped only if it repeats or names the plan. Sol found the earlier version deleted this case; test_a_condition_alone_on_its_line_is_restored pins it, and dropping every wholly doubled line fails 4 tests.

break_it.scenario: A doubled running header contains a number ('SSeeccttiioonn 33').
break_it.what_happens: It is restored as a readable header line instead of removed, adding clutter to the provision text.
break_it.how: Accepted: clutter is visible and harmless, while deleting doubled text that carries a number is how values were lost. Recorded as residual risk.
break_it.repro: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); import dcp_extract_changed as d; print(d.strip_garbled_header_lines('SSeeccttiioonn 3344'))"

mutation_analysis: 73 passed. Mutations: never restore -> 9 failed; never drop headers -> 1; drop every wholly doubled line -> 4; numbers count as doubled words -> 1 (after adding the AABB1122 fixture; it survived without it); one letter is a doubled word -> 5.
residual_risk: A doubled running header that appears once in a provision and does not name the plan is restored as a readable line (clutter, not a loss). Doubled figure captions are restored as readable words. Rows already served change only when their chapter is re-read. Non-doubled junk in the held ku_ring_gai rows ('H H', 'W aste', overlapping page labels) is not addressed here.

post_merge.manual_verify: After the next dcp-extract run (03:00 UTC, --review) re-reads the held ku_ring_gai chapters, their pending rows contain no 'ttoo bbee', 'ooff' or 'KKuu--' residue.
